description:
Per-pool borrow rates across DeFi lending protocols such as Aave, Compound and Morpho. Useful for rate-spread arbitrage screens and stablecoin yield analysis. Use it when the user asks about lending rates, borrow costs or DeFi yield.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_lending_rates
